data.title: 夏洛特 · 温暖厨房的法式甜点投喂
data.description: 弥漫着黄油与香草香气的厨房内，刚出炉的羊角面包金黄酥脆。夏洛特系着浅黄围裙，用白皙的手指轻轻擦去你鼻尖的面粉，眉眼弯弯地发出轻快笑声。
data.action: standing by baking tray, reaching up to wipe flour from partner nose with finger, gentle giggling smile
data.lighting: cozy warm ambient kitchen lighting mixed with soft afternoon daylight
data.mood: heartwarming domestic bliss, playful couple affection, culinary warmth
data.promptProse: Baking in a cozy kitchen wearing an apron, Charlotte laughs tenderly as she wipes a smudge of flour from partner nose.
data.animaCaption: Charlotte laughing tenderly while baking French pastries in a sunny kitchen.
